name: Large Throwing Wheel
ability: After you form a Vase or Censer, gain 1 Clay.

name: Measuring Calipers
ability: After you form two different Shapes during the same Forming action, gain 2 Coins.

name: Clay Substitution
ability: When paying a Forming cost, you may pay 1 Coin instead of 1 Clay.

name: Drying Frames
ability: After you form a ceramic whose Shape matches at least one uncompleted Order in your Order area, gain 1 Coin.

name: Carving Knives
ability: Ignore the Coin cost of one Carved Decoration you apply.

name: Seal Stamps
ability: Ignore the Coin cost of one Impressed Decoration you apply.

name: Colour Samples
ability: Once per round, before choosing your first Order during an Office take-Orders action, you may place 1 face-up Order from either display on the bottom of its deck and reveal a replacement.

name: Kiln Setting
ability: Before Wood Contributions are chosen, move one of your loaded ceramics to any empty kiln space.

name: Protective Saggars
ability: After Quality is assigned, pay 1 Coin to improve one of your ceramics by one step from Flawed to Standard or Standard to Fine.

name: Fuel Ledger
ability: After Contribution cards are revealed but before Base Heat is determined, pay 1 Coin and spend 1 Wood to increase your contribution by 1.

name: Test Pieces
ability: After firing, gain 1 Coin if at least one of your ceramics had a natural exact heat match, plus 1 additional Coin if at least two did.

name: Kiln Records
ability: After firing, if at least two of your ceramics are final Masterpieces, gain 1 Clay and 1 Coin.

name: Connoisseur Network
ability: After a normal Office main action, you may sell exactly one Finished undelivered Masterpiece for 5 Coins and return its Vessel. It cannot follow Court Patronage.

name: Second Firing
ability: After Quality is assigned, return one of your Standard ceramics from the current firing to Glazed without a Quality.

name: Sagger Selection
ability: After the Fire card is revealed, pay 2 Coins so one of your loaded ceramics treats that Fire modifier as 0.
